a: localStorage is synchronous, string-only, and size-limited (~5MB typical).
sessionStorage lasts for the tab session only.
IndexedDB is async structured storage for larger client data.
Cookies are sent with requests; web storage is not.
Cache API stores Response objects for offline/PWA use.
Browsers enforce storage quotas; handle QuotaExceededError.
Some storage features require HTTPS secure contexts.
Modern browsers partition storage to reduce cross-site tracking.
Users or Clear-Site-Data headers can wipe storage.
Do not store secrets or long-lived tokens in accessible web storage.
